snippet.title: Endless Bullet Heaven 1.14: Return to Sender Trailer
snippet.description:
Available now on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1977730/Endless_Bullet_Heaven/

In this endless bullet avoidance game, you join the fallen angel named Brace in her fight to reach the heavens in which she once resided!
